exposure: obstetrician-led cesarean education and antenatal sessions (OCEANS)
Attendance at a one-stop obstetrician-led cesarean education and antenatal sessions (OCEANS)
outcome: Mode of delivery (VBAC vs. repeat CS)
cohort: 266 women with a single previous lower segment Cesarean section
finding: Women who attended the OCEANS session were 38% more likely to opt for a VBAC than those who did not attend.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the rates of successful vaginal delivery between women who attended OCEANS and those who did not.
